mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session ( user_id, thread_id, trace_id, agent_id, provider, provider_session_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{threadId}, #{traceId}, #{agentId}, #{provider}, #{providerSessionId}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), provider_session_id = VALUES(provider_session_id), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
